headline: South African Rand Slips Near R17 Amid Inflation and Soft Growth
summary: The South African rand fell toward R17 per dollar, pressured by expectations of higher US interest rates, elevated domestic fuel prices, and weak national economic growth.
why: The rand is one of the most liquid emerging market currencies, heavily influenced by global commodity prices, US monetary policy, and local economic sentiment.

impacts.name: South African Rand
impacts.why: Rising fuel costs and US rate expectations weighed heavily on South African currency valuation.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Expectations of US monetary tightening alongside rising local petrol prices pressed the rand lower against the US dollar.
